newsitem.title: BRAZIL: EU sends trade envoy to Brazil.
newsitem.headline: EU sends trade envoy to Brazil.

text.p: European Union Trade Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan has appointed a special envoy for trade talks with Brazil, the Brazilian Foreign Ministry said on Thursday.

The ministry said in a statement that the EU would send Jean-Pierre Leng, its former ambassador to Geneva, to Brazil for talks with officials on trade-related issues, in particular the first World Trade Organisation summit in Singapore in December.
"Ambassador Leng will meet (Foreign Minister Luiz Felipe) Lampreia and (Industry and Commerce) Minister (Francisco) Dornelles," the ministry said.
"This visit signals the growing importance with which the EU regards cooperation with Brazil and the need to exert all efforts to ensure full success at the ministerial meeting in Singapore."
